table.retrieve:
SELECT
	creditinvcount=
		(select count(saleinvcode) 
		from saleledger 
		where salecatcode<>3 and  
			saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	cashretinvcount= 
		(select count(srinvcode) 
		from srledger 
		where srcatcode=8 and  
		srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	discinvcount=
		(select count(distinct(SL.saleinvcode)) 
		from saleledger SL,saledetail SD 
		where SL.saleinvcode=SD.saleinvcode and 
			SL.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate and
			(SL.discperc>0 or SL.flatdisc>0 or 
			SD.itemflatdisc>0 OR SD.discperc>0)),
	allsale=reportdata.value1,
	saleqty= ISNULL(
		(select  sum(sd.looseqty + sd.bonusqty + (sd.packqty * sd.packunits))
		from    saleledger sl, saledetail sd, item i, itemcategory ic
		where   sl.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND 
			sl.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode and
			sd.icode = i.icode and ic.name = reportdata.name1 and i.icatcode = ic.icatcode), 0),
	creditsalecount= ISNULL(
		(select  count(sl.saleinvcode)
		from    saleledger sl
		where   sl.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate), 0),
	category=reportdata.name1,
	srvalue=reportdata.value2,
	netsale=reportdata.value1 - reportdata.value2,
	saletax = reportdata.value4,
	returntax = reportdata.value5,
	totaldisc= ( select sum(flatdisc) 
					from saleledger
					where saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	totalsrdisc= ( select sum(flatdisc) 
					 from srledger
					 where srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	misccharg= ( select sum(misccharges) 
					 from saleledger
					 where saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	srmisccharg= ( select sum(misccharges) 
					 from srledger
					 where srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	totalinvdiscperc= (select sum(ISNULL(B.invdiscperc,0))
							from
									(select   /*invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(Round(((saledetail.looseqty + saledetail.packqty * saledetail.packunits) * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc)) * (1 - (.01 * saledetail.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * saleledger.discperc, 0)*/
										invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(saledetail.looseqty * (saledetail.saleprice - saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - saledetail.discperc * 0.01)) * 0.01 * saleledger.discperc, 0)
									 from     saleledger, saledetail  
									 where    
												 (saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate) AND
												 saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode 
									  group by saleledger.saleinvcode,
												  saleledger.discperc
									  ) as  B),
	
	SR_totalinvdiscperc= (select sum(ISNULL(B.invdiscperc,0))
							 from
									(select   /*invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(Round((srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice) * (1 - (.01 * srdetail.discperc)),2)) * 0.01 * srledger.discperc, 0)*/
										invdiscperc = IsNull( sum(srdetail.looseqty * srdetail.srprice * (1 - srdetail.discperc * 0.01) * 0.01 * srledger.discperc), 0)
									 from     srledger, srdetail  
									 where    
												 srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate AND
												 srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode 
									  group by srledger.srinvcode, srledger.discperc
								) as  B),

	diff=(SELECT sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
			FROM
				(SELECT 
						rounddifference= ISNULL(dbo.fn_GetSaleInvTotal(dbo.saleledger.SaleInvCode), 0)
						-
						((Sum ( 
							dbo.saledetail.looseqty * 
							(dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * 
							(1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01) * 
							(1 - dbo.saleledger.discperc * 0.01) ) + 
							dbo.saleledger.misccharges - saleledger.flatdisc) +
						
							SUM( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty + dbo.saledetail.bonusqty) * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * dbo.saledetail.discperc)) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)) *
								(1 - (.01 * dbo.saledetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * dbo.saleledger.discperc)) -
								dbo.saleledger.flatdisc) * (dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2))
					FROM dbo.saleledger, dbo.saledetail
					WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
							/*( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (3,1) ) and  */
							(saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)
					GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
						dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
						dbo.saleledger.date,   
						dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
						dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
						dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
						dbo.saleledger.invGSTPerc1, 
						dbo.saleledger.salecatcode
					) as A),

	srdiff=(select sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
			from
	
				(SELECT 
							rounddifference= ISNULL(dbo.fn_GetSRInvTotal(dbo.srledger.SRInvCode), 0)
							-
						  ((Sum ( 
									dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * 
									(1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01) * 
									(1 - dbo.srledger.discperc * 0.01) ) + 
									dbo.srledger.misccharges - srledger.flatdisc) +
						Round(
							SUM( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty + dbo.srdetail.bonusqty) * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax) + 
							SUM(ROUND( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.saleprice) *
								(1 - (.01 * dbo.srdetail.discperc)) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * .01, 2)) +
							ROUND( (SUM((dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.saleprice) *
								(1 - (.01 * dbo.srdetail.discperc))) * (1- (.01 * dbo.srledger.discperc)) -
								dbo.srledger.flatdisc) * (dbo.srledger.invgstperc1 * .01), 2), 0))
					FROM     dbo.srledger, dbo.srdetail
					WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and 
							/*( dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (6,8) ) and  */
						( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)          
					GROUP BY dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
								dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
								dbo.srledger.date,   
								dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
								dbo.srledger.discperc,  
								dbo.srledger.salestax,
								dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
								dbo.srledger.srcatcode
					) as A),
/*
	diff=(select sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
			from
	
				(SELECT 
							rounddifference= Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
													- Sum ( Round(dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100) 
													+ dbo.saleledger.misccharges - saleledger.flatdisc,0)  
	
							-
	
						  (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2)
													- Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
													+ dbo.saleledger.misccharges - saleledger.flatdisc)
							,
						 netammount= (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice)
										 - Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.saleledger.flatdisc + dbo.saleledger.misccharges )
	
					FROM     dbo.saleledger, 
								dbo.saledetail
	
					WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
							/*( dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (3,1) ) and  */
							 (saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)          
	
					GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
								dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
								dbo.saleledger.date,   
								dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
								dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
								dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
								dbo.saleledger.salecatcode
					) as A),

	srdiff=(select sum ( ISNULL(A.rounddifference,0)) 
			from
	
				(SELECT 
							rounddifference= Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2)
													- Sum ( Round(dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100) 
													+ dbo.srledger.misccharges - srledger.flatdisc,0)  
	
							-
	
						  (Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice)
													- Round(Sum (Round( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty *dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01),2)), 2)
													- Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100)
													+ dbo.srledger.misccharges - srledger.flatdisc)
							,
						 netammount= (Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice)
										 - Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)), 2)), 2) + Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2) + dbo.srledger.flatdisc + dbo.srledger.misccharges )
	
					FROM     dbo.srledger, 
								dbo.srdetail
	
					WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and 
							/*( dbo.srledger.srcatcode IN (6,8) ) and  */
						( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate)          
					GROUP BY dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
								dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
								dbo.srledger.date,   
								dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
								dbo.srledger.discperc,  
								dbo.srledger.salestax, 
								dbo.srledger.srcatcode
					) as A),
*/
	srtotal=(select  ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_getsrinvtotal(dbo.srledger.srinvcode)),0)
				from srledger
				where srledger.srcatcode IN ( 8,6) and 
					srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),

	creditsale=  (select ISNULL(SUM(dbo.fn_getsaleinvtotal(dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode)),0)
					from saleledger
					where
						saleledger.salecatcode = 2 AND
						saleledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate),
	
	totaltax=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(Round(INV.itemsalestax + invtax,0) ),0)
				FROM
						(Select itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
						invtax=	Round ( (Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice) 
												 -   Round(Sum (Round(( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc),2)), 2) 
												 -  Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100)
												 - saleledger.flatdisc ) * saleledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)
						FROM saleledger, saledetail
						WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and 
								( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate) 
						GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
									dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
									dbo.saleledger.date,   
									dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
									dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
									dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
									dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 										
							 ) as INV),
	
	sr_totaltax=(SELECT ISNULL( SUM(Round(INV.itemsalestax + invtax,0) ),0)
				FROM
						(Select itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
						invtax=
							Round ( ( 
								Sum(dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice) 
								- Sum (Round(dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01, 2))
								- Sum ((Round(dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01), 2) * dbo.srledger.discperc * 0.01) - srledger.flatdisc)) * srledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01, 2)
						FROM srledger, srdetail
						WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and 
								( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate) 
						GROUP BY 
								dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
									dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
									dbo.srledger.date,   
									dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
									dbo.srledger.discperc,  
									dbo.srledger.salestax, 
									dbo.srledger.invgstperc1 										
							 ) as INV),
	
	cashsalecount=  
		IsNull(
		(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT SLL.SaleInvCode) 
		FROM saleledger sll 
		where sll.salecatcode in (3) and sll.date between :ar_startdate and :ar_enddate), 0),
	serverdatetime=getdate()

FROM reportdata
order by category

objects.name: compute_11
objects.expression: Round(sum( allsale ) -  totaldisc  -  totalinvdiscperc  + totaltax +  misccharg  +  diff, 0)

objects.name: compute_13
objects.expression: Round(sum( allsale ) -  totaldisc  -  totalinvdiscperc  + totaltax +  misccharg  +  diff, 0) - creditsale

objects.name: compute_4
objects.expression: Round(sum( allsale ) -  totaldisc  -  totalinvdiscperc  + totaltax +  misccharg  +  diff , 0) -  srtotal   -  creditsale
